This update is notable for adding the [[Slime Trooper]] tower. This update encompassed four versions, the main v1.90.0 update (released 8 May 2026) and three minor updates, the v1.90.0a (released 8 May 2026), 1.90.1 (released 15 May 2026) and 1.90.1a (released 15 May 2026). ==Additions== ===Towers=== *[[Slime Trooper]] ==Changes & Bugfixes== *[[Ace Pilot]] buffed. **Statistical changes: ***'''Level 3''' ****Damage increased from +0 to +1. ****Firerate changed from {{Tooltip|0.225 > 0.125|-0.1}} to {{Tooltip|0.225 > 0.15|-0.075}}. ***'''Level 4''' ****Cost increased from {{Money|2,500}} to {{Money|3,000}}. ****Damage increased from +2 to +3. ****Now gives towers hidden detection. ****Hidden detection range increased from 0 to 10. ***'''Level 5''' ****Cost decreased from {{Money|9,500}} to {{Money|7,000}}. ****Damage increased from +9 to +10. ***'''Level 6''' ****Range decreased from +2.5 to +1.5. ****[[War Machine Sentry]] health increased from 300 to 1,000. ****[[War Machine Sentry]] explosion damage increased from 70 to 75. *[[Firework Technician]] rebalanced. **Increased the chance of the [[Soldier]] generating fireworks by making it divide the result of the equation by 1.5 instead of 2. **Increased the chance of the [[Shotgunner]] generating fireworks by making it divide the result of the equation by 10 instead of 13. **Reduced the chance of the [[Saboteur]] generating fireworks by making it divide the result of the equation by 11. **Statistical changes: ***'''Base''' ****Range increased from 8 to 10. *[[Harvester]] nerfed. **Statistical changes: ***'''Base''' ****Thorn slowdown decreased from 20% to 15%. ***'''Level 2''' ****Thorn slowdown changed from 20% > 25% to 15% > 20%. ***'''Level 5''' ****Thorn slowdown changed from 30% > 40% to 20% > 30%. *[[Saboteur]] buffed in regular modes. **Statistical changes: ***'''Base''' ****Lead detection added, moved from Level 2. ***'''Level 1''' ****Cost decreased from {{Money|550}} to {{Money|500}}. ***'''Level 2''' ****Poison time changed from 3 > 4 to 3 > 5. ***'''Level 3''' ****Cost decreased from {{Money|5,150}} to {{Money|4,850}}. ****Poison time changed from 4 > 5.5 to 5 > 6. ****''Paralyzing Toxins'' cooldown decreased from 120 to 100. ****''Paralyzing Toxins'' initial cooldown decreased from 60 to 30. ***'''Level 4''' ****Bullet count changed from 4 > 5 to 4 > 6. ****Poison time changed from 5.5 > 7 to 6 > 7. *Fixed [[Swarmer]]
